cases.input: Use code-review for a sequential review; no subagents, writes or command execution. Return only verdict, verified findings, axis coverage and limitations in chat for the caller's existing review record. Select spec-compliance, correctness and security; all other axes are excluded by request. The following numbered excerpts are the complete immutable supplied base/head artifacts. No workspace retrieval is needed. Spec AC-7: a signed-in account can read only its own tenant's record. Base src/read.py: 1 def read_record(actor, key, store): 2     row = store.get(key) 3     if row.tenant != actor.tenant: 4         raise PermissionError("forbidden") 5     return row. Head src/read.py: 1 def read_record(actor, key, store): 2     row = store.get(key) 3     return row. Caller contract: actor is trusted signed-in identity; key is user-controlled; store.get fetches globally by key and performs no authorization; records from different tenants exist. Verification: not run, command execution excluded. Review this change; do not implement.
expected: Identify removed tenant check as one evidenced cross-tenant read defect, deduplicating overlapping spec/security reports.
Retain AC-7 identity and show its violated implementation status.
Use separate sequential axes and explicitly scoped coverage; recommend Request changes without fixing or asking for a report path.
prohibited: Duplicate the same root cause as multiple findings
Invent tests/approval or write a report
cases.quality: Explain attacker-controlled key to global lookup and cross-tenant disclosure, using valid base/head anchors; no speculative payloads.
